# UX Requirements Quality Checklist: QuestIt Core

**Purpose**: Release gate — validar que los requisitos de UX (feedback de
interacción, estados de carga/error, responsive, accesibilidad) estén
completos, claros y sin ambigüedad antes de aprobar la feature para
release, cubriendo las 4 historias de usuario de forma balanceada.
**Created**: 2026-08-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [quickstart.md](../quickstart.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command
based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are loading-state requirements defined in the spec (not
  only in the constitution) for every asynchronous action — crear/editar/
  eliminar/completar tarea, crear/editar/eliminar/cumplir hábito, login/
  registro/logout? [Gap, Spec §FR-004–FR-011, Constitución Principio V]
  → Resuelto: FR-025 agregado (2026-08-03).
- [x] CHK002 - Are error-state requirements (what the user sees on
  failure) defined for each of those same asynchronous actions, beyond
  the two cases already covered in Edge Cases (login inválido, hábito
  duplicado)? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
  → Resuelto: FR-025 agregado (2026-08-03).
- [x] CHK003 - Are empty-state requirements defined for the tareas list
  and the hábitos list when the user has none yet, beyond the panel's
  zero-value case already specified? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
  → Resuelto: FR-028 agregado (2026-08-04).
- [x] CHK004 - Is a confirmation/undo requirement defined for destructive
  actions (eliminar tarea, eliminar hábito), or is immediate deletion
  without confirmation an explicit decision? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, FR-010]
  → Resuelto: FR-006/FR-010 exigen confirmación explícita (2026-08-04).
- [x] CHK005 - Are accessibility requirements (keyboard navigation,
  screen reader labeling, color contrast) specified anywhere for the
  feature, given none currently appear in spec.md? [Gap, Coverage]
  → Resuelto: FR-026 agregado (accesibilidad básica) (2026-08-04).
- [x] CHK006 - Is the UI pattern for incremental history loading (e.g.,
  "cargar más" button vs. scroll infinito) specified, or left fully open
  to implementation? [Gap, Spec §FR-020]
  → Resuelto: FR-020 especifica botón "Cargar más" (2026-08-04).

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 - Is the exact wording/content of the "hábito ya registrado
  hoy" message specified, or only its intent? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-023]
  → Resuelto: FR-023 especifica el texto exacto (2026-08-04).
- [x] CHK008 - Is "sin pérdida de funcionalidad" (SC-004) quantified with
  specific criteria (e.g., which interactions must remain available at
  360px) rather than left as a qualitative statement? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004]
  → Resuelto: SC-004 reformulado referenciando explícitamente las
  Historias 1-4 (2026-08-03).
- [x] CHK009 - Are the breakpoints implied by "mobile, tablet, desktop"
  (Constitución Principio VI) mapped to concrete pixel ranges consistent
  with the 360px–1920px bound in SC-004? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004]
  → Resuelto: SC-004 especifica mobile 360–767px, tablet 768–1023px,
  desktop 1024–1920px (2026-08-04).
- [x] CHK010 - Is the validation feedback for registro/login form errors
  (email con formato inválido, password < 8 caracteres) specified at the
  field level, or only as a rejection outcome? [Clarity, Spec §US1 Acceptance Scenarios]
  → Resuelto: FR-029 agregado (2026-08-04).
- [x] CHK011 - Is "acceso inmediato a la aplicación" after auto-login on
  registro (Clarifications 2026-08-03) defined in terms of which
  screen/state the user lands on? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications]
  → Resuelto: FR-001 especifica redirección al panel principal (2026-08-04).

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 - Are loading/error feedback requirements applied uniformly
  across the tarea flow and the hábito flow, or does one historia specify
  more interaction detail than the other? [Consistency, Spec §US2, §US3]
  → Confirmado (no gap): FR-025, FR-028, FR-030 se redactaron de forma
  simétrica para tareas y hábitos (2026-08-04).
- [x] CHK013 - Is the last-write-wins behavior (Clarifications, Session
  2026-08-01) consistent with a UX requirement to inform the "losing"
  device/tab that its change was overwritten, or is silence the intended
  behavior end-to-end? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
  → Confirmado (no gap): silencio es el comportamiento intencional; no
  se agrega notificación (decisión 2026-08-03).
- [x] CHK014 - Do the acceptance scenarios for editar/eliminar de otro
  usuario (US2 Scenario 6, US3 Scenario 5) specify the same user-facing
  rejection experience (message, redirect, silent no-op)? [Consistency, Spec §US2, §US3]
  → Resuelto: FR-021 y Edge Cases exigen mensaje explícito de acceso
  denegado, aplicado uniformemente (2026-08-04).

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 - Can SC-001 ("crear, editar o eliminar en menos de 2
  segundos, p95") be verified from a pure UX perspective — i.e., does the
  spec define what the user perceives during that window (spinner,
  disabled button) so "completarse" is testable end-to-end and not only
  server-side? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
  → Resuelto: SC-001 referencia el estado de carga de FR-025 como límite
  de medición (2026-08-04).
- [x] CHK016 - Is SC-005 ("registrarse, crear su primera tarea o hábito y
  completarla... en menos de 5 minutos") measurable independent of a
  specific UI flow, or does it implicitly assume an undefined number of
  steps/screens? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
  → Resuelto: SC-005 referencia los Acceptance Scenarios de Historias 1-3
  como el flujo de pasos válido (2026-08-04).

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK017 - Are Primary flow UX requirements complete for all 4
  historias (auth, tareas, hábitos, panel)? [Coverage, Spec §US1–US4]
  → Confirmado (no gap): con FR-025 a FR-030 y los Acceptance Scenarios
  existentes, las 4 historias cubren carga, error, confirmación,
  accesibilidad y estados vacíos (2026-08-04).
- [x] CHK018 - Are Exception/Error flow UX requirements (credenciales
  inválidas, email duplicado, hábito duplicado, acceso a datos ajenos)
  fully enumerated, or are there failure modes without a defined
  user-facing response (e.g., error de red al guardar, sesión expirada a
  mitad de una acción)? [Gap, Exception Flow]
  → Resuelto: FR-025 cubre error genérico de red/guardado; FR-027 cubre
  sesión expirada a mitad de acción (2026-08-04).
- [x] CHK019 - Are Recovery flow requirements defined for a failed save
  (e.g., puede el usuario reintentar sin perder lo ya ingresado en el
  formulario)? [Gap, Recovery]
  → Resuelto: FR-030 agregado (2026-08-04).
- [x] CHK020 - Are Non-Functional UX requirements (responsive, Lighthouse
  Performance ≥90, TTI <3s) traceable to a specific screen/flow, or only
  stated globally? [Coverage, Spec §SC-002, Constitución Principio VII]
  → Confirmado (no gap): SC-002 (panel), SC-004 (todas las historias) y
  SC-001 (CRUD) ya delimitan cada NFR a una pantalla/flujo específico;
  Lighthouse/TTI quedan como métricas globales de plan.md por diseño
  (2026-08-04).

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK021 - Are UX requirements defined for a user submitting a form
  (crear tarea/hábito, registro) with a título/nombre/descripción at or
  beyond the newly clarified length limits (1–100 / 0–500 caracteres)?
  [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004, FR-008]
  → Resuelto: FR-004/FR-008 especifican bloqueo de envío + mensaje de
  validación por campo (2026-08-04).
- [x] CHK022 - Are UX requirements defined for the historial view when a
  user has exactly one page (fewer than 20 eventos), regarding whether a
  "cargar más" affordance is shown at all? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-020]
  → Resuelto: FR-020 especifica que el botón se oculta con menos de 20
  eventos (2026-08-04).
- [x] CHK023 - Are UX requirements defined for concurrent duplicate
  submissions (e.g., doble click en "completar tarea" antes de que
  responda el servidor) to prevent double XP or duplicate requests?
  [Edge Case, Gap]
  → Resuelto: FR-024 agregado, simétrico a FR-023 para hábitos (2026-08-03).

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK024 - Is the assumption that no email verification is required
  (Spec §Assumptions) reflected consistently in the registro UX
  requirements (i.e., no "verifica tu email" screen implied elsewhere)?
  [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
  → Resuelto: FR-001 confirma explícitamente que no hay pantallas
  intermedias de verificación de email (2026-08-04).
- [x] CHK025 - Is the dependency on session/auth mechanics deferred to
  planning (Spec §Assumptions) resolved enough in plan.md to know what
  UX happens when a session expires mid-use? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, plan.md]
  → Resuelto: FR-027 y nuevo Edge Case definen mensaje + redirect a login
  (2026-08-04).
